bluf: Right Side Up is a US growth marketing firm that sells vetted, AI fluent marketers as fractional talent, full time hires, agency teams or executive strategy, with GEO the only capability the record scores above 1. It runs its own Google and LinkedIn ads (live on 2026-09-27), published case studies through 2026-06-24 and AI marketing blog posts dated 2026-09-22, and the Horus read places it in the Favored band at +13 on that GEO line. The one thing a rival should know: its 6 named clients are names only, so every account is contestable on evidence, and Reddit and Homebase already sit on other tracked agencies' books.
doing:
The positioning line describes a staffing model more than a delivery shop: Right Side Up assembles vetted, AI fluent marketers and sells them as fractional talent, full time hires, agency teams or executive strategy, and its headline claim promises vetted talent recommendations far faster than a traditional eight week recruiting process. That is a speed claim about recruiting, not a results claim about marketing, and the record holds no figure behind it.

The services list runs to growth and marketing strategy, B2B advertising, affiliate marketing, GEO, podcast, radio and TV, Amazon marketing, creative services, freelancers, agency teams, full time employees, advisors and advisory services for investors. The capability table is thin under that list: AI Search / GEO is the only core line and the only one scored at 2, with the evidence note reading GEO in nav, GEO service and AI visibility audit pages, a GEO guide and a GEO 101 webinar. Eight lines score 1 with no evidence note (AI automation, B2B and ABM, email and CRM, paid search, paid social, programmatic and CTV, retail media, SEO); CRO, content and PR, creator, data and measurement, local and web score 0. The record lists no proprietary product and no partners.

AI posture: it sells GEO and AI visibility audits and markets senior operators who help marketing teams turn AI tools into adoption. The Horus read scores P1 (sell AI visibility as an audited product) as making but P6 (retrain juniors into agent operators) as absent, because no AI operator depth or talent pipeline shows in the record, and its Lever ATS carries 0 open jobs.

The moves and news lists are empty; the dated record is the case study stream, from 2025-04-03 (Ethena, Workrise, and a software company credited to Right Percent) through 2025-12-18 (Fabric by Gerber Life, Homebase), 2026-01-09 (Dipsea), 2026-04-20 (a consumer goods company on Amazon Ads and on audio) and 2026-05-11 (Reddit) to 2026-06-24 (audio advertisers, radio attribution). Blog slugs dated 2026-09-22 (AI marketing workflows, a ChatGPT ads guide) show where the publishing points. The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent: no office, founding year, headcount or ownership, no partner badges, and a data and measurement score of 0 beside a case study slugged radio attribution.
clients:
The client type is mixed and the verticals the record lists are consumer apps and subscription, B2B SaaS and software, online platforms and marketplaces, ecommerce and Amazon sellers, and investors and portfolio companies; the home market is the US and the record lists no office.

The needs read names 6 clients, 0 observed and 6 names only. Every row carries the code N0, engagement named only: Reddit (case study, Reddit x Right Side Up, dated 2026-05-11), Dipsea (case study, 2026-01-09), Ethena (case study, 2025-04-03), Workrise (case study, 2025-04-03), Homebase (case study, 2025-12-18) and Fabric (case study slug, Fabric by Gerber Life x Right Side Up, 2025-12-18). The excerpt on every case study reads Back to case studies, so the record holds the client name and the date and nothing about the work; the need for each is inferred from the sold mix, which with GEO as the only scored line and Amazon Ads, audio and radio attribution in the anonymised titles points to paid performance and commerce and marketplaces, said as inferred. One observed signal sits outside the needs read: a LinkedIn ad sample says Homebase built an affiliate program that drives real brand visibility, which reads as paid performance work the needs read has not credited.

Two clients shop: Reddit also appears on the book of moburst and Homebase on the book of go-fish-digital (shared_n 2). The rest of the case study stream is anonymised (a consumer goods company, a premium grocery brand, audio advertisers), so the named book is 6 of 6 names only.

What the base needs next: under KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two), the consumer app and SaaS names are likely to need AI visibility measurement and owned audience hedges, with moderate confidence, because the record shows GEO as the one capability with evidence and nothing scored in data and measurement.

market:
The Horus read scores Right Side Up at +13, the 54th percentile, Favored band, resilience 33.8, the sold mix at 15:38 on the Solar Arc, afternoon (Ra to Atum). It is best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.35, driven by AI Search / GEO at 2, SEO at -1, paid search at 1), and KJ2, ads inside AI answers (net 0.263). It is most exposed to KJ5, the price of attention splits in two (net -0.135, paid social and programmatic and CTV at -1 each), and KJ4, the platforms absorbing the execution layer (net -0.088, paid search and paid social at -2). Best scenario fit is The Bazaar of Agents at 45/100. It is making P1, partial on P7 (some owned audience work shows), absent on P2, P6 and P8, unknown on P5; P3 and P4 do not apply.

The Monsoon read is 45.2, Breeze, 16th percentile: migration 43.7 against displacement 46.7, so displacement runs slightly ahead. 44 of the index is the sold mix, with AI Search / GEO and SEO at 9 each carrying the most movable hours; the shore split is 65% South and Southeast Asia and 25% Latin America, and automation overlaps 22% of the movable hours. The evidence class is inferred (the only term is icp_mixed): no hub office and no onshore claim appear in the record.
openings:
The strongest opening is evidentiary: the client book is 6 of 6 names only, with every case study excerpt reading Back to case studies, so a rival that documents named outcomes for consumer app, SaaS and marketplace clients is very likely (moderate confidence) to win an evidence comparison against any of Reddit, Dipsea, Ethena, Workrise, Homebase or Fabric. The falsifier: if the case study pages carry described work and figures when read in full, the thin evidence read collapses and the contest returns to price and talent.

Lead with the operator contradiction: it markets senior AI fluent operators, yet the Horus read scores P6 as absent and its Lever ATS shows 0 open jobs, so a rival with a visible operator bench and published AI workflows is likely to undercut the pitch. The record lists no pricing model, which makes a transparent, outcome priced offer a conversation it cannot have in public. P2 is absent, so feeds, schema and entity work under its own GEO line is unclaimed; P8 is absent, so ads inside assistants are untested despite a ChatGPT ads guide on its blog. The KJ5 exposure runs through paid social and programmatic and CTV, both scored 1 with no evidence, the lines a rival is most likely to take. Reddit (moburst) and Homebase (go-fish-digital) are shoppers.
